description: One neuron circuit, three inputs summed then rectified and compared, with a two-against-two difference rectifier below it

params.text: Adds a steady 0V to 5V into the neuron's mix before the mix is rectified
Sets the size of the comparator swing, 1V to 10V; that much is taken off the rectified mix while the mix is above 0V and added to it while it is not

inputs.text: One of three signals summed into the neuron; the sum plus SENSE is clamped to 0V to 10V before the comparator swing is applied
Summed with the other IN- jack, and that total taken away from the IN+ pair
Summed with the other IN+ jack, and the IN- pair taken away from that total

outputs.text: The rectified neuron mix with the comparator swing applied
The IN+ pair less the IN- pair while that difference is negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time
The IN+ pair less the IN- pair while that difference is positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time

notes: with nothing patched and SENSE fully anticlockwise, OUT rests at whatever RESPONSE is set to, because the comparator swings negative whenever the rectified mix is not above 0V.
the neuron and the difference rectifier share no connection inside the module; patch the neuron's OUT into one of the rectifier's inputs to join them.
